title: Russian-Style Tomato Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired pilaf dish made with Russian and tomato flavors, served with a silky twist.
instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add pilaf seasoning and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add basmati rice and stir to coat with butter and seasoning.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes, until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and season with salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
